Accuracy Class C
Maximum number of load cell intervals (n) 7500 7500 10000
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / Vmin		 25000 50000 50000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		 12400 30000 30000
